name: wittStructureRat_rec_aux

statement: MvPolynomial idx ℤ) (n : ℕ) (IH : ∀ m : ℕ, m < n + 1 → map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) (wittStructureInt p Φ m) = wittStructureRat p (map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) Φ) m) : bind₁ (fun b => rename (fun i => (b, i)) (expand p (W_ ℤ n))) Φ = bind₁ (fun i => expand p (wittStructureInt p Φ i)) (W_ ℤ n)
